title: 10 independent cyclic components with exact weight-indexed admission

claims.statement: The explicit product of 10 cyclic codes, each with 2 degree-50 fields, and its fixed radius-10 adaptive decoder carries 1000 bits on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses with average block error at most 953564703246752699/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=663155043702000 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(49237/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles (0), field, orbit count and primitive bound (1), exact weight-indexed child admission (2), and final weighted balance and occupancy (3).
